components.name: Button
components.description: Default instrument key: Surface 1 fill, strong hairline border.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="7"/><line x1="12" y1="2" x2="12" y2="5"/><line x1="12" y1="19" x2="12" y2="22"/><line x1="2" y1="12" x2="5" y2="12"/><line x1="19" y1="12" x2="22" y2="12"/></svg>Locate</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 30px; padding: 0 11px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, rgba(148,178,204,0.22)); background: var(--surface-1, #0c1420); color: var(--text-1, #e6eef4); font: 500 12.5px 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #121c2b); border-color: rgba(148,178,204,0.32); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(0.5px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #7fe0c4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per view, in Biolume Aqua.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 30px; padding: 0 11px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #7fe0c4; background: #7fe0c4; color: #04130e; font: 600 12.5px 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9aead3; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7fe0c4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Speed Transport
components.description: Segmented well for pause and simulation speed; pressed speed takes the aqua wash.
components.css: .ds-transport { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; background: #0c1420; border: 1px solid rgba(148,178,204,0.12); border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-transport button { height: 28px; min-width: 34px; padding: 0 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #a9b8c6; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-transport button:hover { background: #121c2b; color: #e6eef4; } .ds-transport button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: rgba(127,224,196,0.14); color: #7fe0c4; } .ds-transport button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7fe0c4; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tps { color: #7d90a3; font-size: 11px; padding: 0 8px 0 6px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Dashboard Tabs
components.description: Equal-width tabs; selected tab gets a 2px aqua underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 6px 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148,178,204,0.12); background: #0a1019; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; height: 34px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #7d90a3; font: 600 12px 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; border-radius: 7px 7px 0 0; position: relative; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: #e6eef4; background: #0c1420; } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true'] { color: #e6eef4; } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 10px; right: 10px; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; background: #7fe0c4; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7fe0c4; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Rail Button
components.description: God-tool rail key; active tool takes the aqua wash and a left-edge bar.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 6px; background: rgba(9,14,22,0.9); border: 1px solid rgba(148,178,204,0.12); border-radius: 10px; } .ds-rail-btn { width: 38px; height: 31px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 7px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #a9b8c6; cursor: pointer; position: relative; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-rail-btn:hover { background: #121c2b; color: #e6eef4; } .ds-rail-btn[aria-pressed='true'] { background: rgba(127,224,196,0.14); color: #7fe0c4; } .ds-rail-btn[aria-pressed='true']::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -6px; top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: #7fe0c4; } .ds-rail-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7fe0c4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: Label, capsule track filled in the entity hue, species-mean tick, tabular value.
components.html: Speed0.62
components.css: .ds-trait { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px 1fr 34px; gap: 8px; align-items: center; width: 300px; font: 400 11.5px 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-t-label { color: #a9b8c6; } .ds-t-track { position: relative; height: 6px; background: #121c2b; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-t-fill { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; border-radius: 6px; opacity: 0.85; } .ds-t-mark { position: absolute; top: -3px; width: 2px; height: 12px; background: #e6eef4; border-radius: 1px; opacity: 0.75; } .ds-t-val { text-align: right; color: #a9b8c6; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-panel { width: 300px; padding: 14px; background: rgba(9,14,22,0.9); border: 1px solid rgba(148,178,204,0.12); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.65), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.1); color: #e6eef4; font: 400 13px/1.45 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-panel dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 3px 12px; font-size: 12px; margin: 0; } .ds-panel dt { color: #7d90a3; } .ds-panel dd { margin: 0; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
WORLD ZERO is a single screen: a full-bleed painted planet with a ring of quiet instruments around it. The map is the only thing allowed to be bright. Panels are dark, nearly opaque ocean-night slabs with hairline cool rules; they blur what moves beneath them only because they float over a living map. Everything that is not the world steps back: secondary text sits at a cool slate, numbers are tabular so they can tick without jitter, and colour in the chrome is spent sparingly so the species and tribe hues on the map can carry meaning.

Density is that of a scientific instrument, not a dashboard of tiles. Information arrives as compact lists, key/value columns, small multiples of line charts and trait bars, with 13px Inter as the working voice. One live accent, a pale biolume aqua, marks what you have selected, what has focus, and the one primary action; warm amber marks events and warnings; red and green are reserved for status. The system refuses the neon sci-fi HUD: no glowing borders on every box, no stat tiles for their own sake.

Motion is state, not spectacle: 150 to 250ms transitions on the shared out-expo curve, a camera that eases out when it flies to an event, and no page-load choreography.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed canvas map with floating instrument panels around it
Ocean-night neutrals in three surface steps plus a translucent floating panel
One accent (biolume aqua) reserved for selection, focus, and primary
Amber for events and warnings; species and tribe hues are data, never decoration
Inter with tabular numerals everywhere; Chakra Petch only on the wordmark and map labels
Hairline cool rules instead of boxes and glows

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Biolume aqua appears only on selection, focus, and the single primary action. If it marks anything else, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Data Owns Hue Rule
rules.body: Species and tribe colours come from the simulation and are reused verbatim everywhere that entity appears. Chrome never borrows them, and they never stand in for status.

rules.name: The Three Series Rule
rules.body: Charts use series-1, series-2, series-3 by meaning, not by order, and never introduce a fourth chrome series colour; multi-species charts use species hues instead.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change is set in tabular numerals, so live counts never shift the layout.

rules.name: The Cartographer's Face Rule
rules.body: Chakra Petch is for the wordmark and for names drawn on the map, nothing else. Headings, buttons, and numbers stay in Inter.

rules.name: The Blur Over Motion Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur (10px, saturate 1.1) is applied only to panels floating over the live map. Dialogs and tooltips are solid.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Borders are hairline rules in cool slate. Nothing in the chrome glows; glows belong to the map (fires, settlement lights at night, torches).

dos: Do reserve Biolume Aqua (#7fe0c4) for selection, focus, and the one primary action per view.
Do set every changing number in tabular numerals.
Do carry a species or tribe colour unchanged from the map into every list, swatch, bar, label and chart where that entity appears.
Do assign chart colours by meaning from the three series tokens, with direct labels on the latest value and a table toggle.
Do blur panels only when they float over the live map; use the solid panel for dialogs, tooltips and menus.
Do separate sections with a hairline rule and spacing, not with nested cards.
Do keep state transitions between 150 and 260ms on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) and let the camera ease out on fly-to.
Do collapse to the bottom sheet, rail toggle and overflow menu at 720px and below.
donts: Don't add glowing borders, neon outlines or coloured box shadows to chrome; glow belongs to the map.
Don't build stat tiles for their own sake; numbers live in fact grids, key/value lists and lead figures.
Don't use Chakra Petch for headings, buttons or numbers.
Don't use species or tribe hues as status colours, or status colours as data.
Don't add page-load choreography or animate anything that is not a state change.
Don't introduce a second accent; amber is for events and warnings, not emphasis.
